title: GET /api/tasks/:id always returns 404
description: When calling GET /api/tasks/1, the server always returns 404 even though the task exists. The bug is in taskController.ts in the getTaskById function. The route param `req.params.id` is a string but is being compared with `===` against `t.id` which is a number. Fix: parse the id to integer using parseInt() before the comparison.
